say.title: Speak to the people in the room
say.description: Say a short message aloud to the crew or the operator: one or two sentences in their language, what happened and what you did, with the numbers you were given. Speech is for the moment; written reports go to the crew tool. The audio is played by the outputs in order; you get the utterance identifier back. Mother (station) finishes the current sentence, then reads only the newest pending message, without interruption.

properties.text: What to say aloud, 1500 characters at most
properties.voice: Who speaks: a speaker name from the profile (agent, twin, factory, station) or an engine voice identifier
properties.priority: Mother (station) is never interrupted by a new announcement and keeps only the newest waiting message. Other voices: high interrupts, low waits, normal by default.

stop.title: Stop speaking
stop.description: Stop the audio outputs: one utterance by its identifier, or everything queued so far.

properties.utteranceId: One utterance to withdraw; everything queued when absent
